headline: Petrobras and PRIO Shares Fall up to 8% Amid Oil Price Slump
summary: Shares of Petrobras, PRIO, and other oil companies dropped up to 8% as main crude commodity contracts faced a third consecutive session of losses.
why: Oil price movements directly impact upstream exploration and production revenue streams for energy companies.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Lower crude prices reduce projected revenues for upstream petroleum producers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in global crude oil prices directly reduces the expected asset valuation and earnings potential of petroleum exploration companies.
